Instagram Mixcloud Website Lucía was one of the volunteers who built the first studio out of a storage room in Poblenou. She has hosted Marea Baja every Sunday since the station went on air. On Wednesdays she hosts Pati de Llums, bringing local bands into the studio to play live and talk. She picks records that sound good at low volume with the windows open, and she never talks over a track. On air Every week with Lucía.
